title: Two Sum
description:
Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `target`, return **indices of the two numbers** such that they add up to `target`.

You may assume that each input would have **exactly one solution**, and you may not use the same element twice.

You can return the answer in any order.
solution_approach: Single-pass hash table mapping element values to their indices.
hints: Can you solve this without checking every pair in O(N^2)?
What data structure provides O(1) average lookup for the complement target - num?
Check if the complement exists in your lookup table before storing the current element.
follow_up_questions: Follow-up: Can you come up with an algorithm that is less than O(n^2) time complexity?
